cards.claim: The CBSE Class XI Physics curriculum for 2026-27 lists Chapter 3 'Motion in a Plane' under Unit II Kinematics, covering scalars and vectors, vector algebra, resolution into rectangular components, scalar and vector products, and motion in a plane including projectile motion and uniform circular motion.
cards.quote: Motion in a plane, cases of uniform velocity and uniform acceleration - projectile motion, uniform circular motion.

locator.section: Class XI - 2026-27 (Theory), Unit II: Kinematics, Chapter-3: Motion in a Plane

cards.claim: The CBSE 2026-27 Class XI curriculum's vector content for this chapter includes position and displacement vectors, equality of vectors, multiplication by a real number, addition and subtraction, unit vectors and resolution into rectangular components.
cards.quote: Scalar and vector quantities; position and displacement vectors, general vectors and their notations; equality of vectors, multiplication of vectors by a real number; addition and subtraction of vectors, Unit vector; resolution of a vector in a plane, rectangular components,

locator.section: Class XI - 2026-27 (Theory), Unit II: Kinematics, Chapter-3: Motion in a Plane

cards.claim: The NCERT Class XI Physics Part I chapter 'Motion in a Plane' (reprint 2026-27) introduces vectors, then motion in a plane with constant acceleration, projectile motion in detail, and uniform circular motion.
cards.quote: As a simple case of motion in a plane, we shall discuss motion with constant acceleration and treat in detail the projectile motion.
